title: fleischmannia seleriana
intro: Fleischmannia seleriana, commonly known as Guanabano, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America, belonging to the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its rich content of bioactive compounds. The plant is reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and pain. The bioactive constituents of Fleischmannia seleriana include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as sedation, spasmolytic, and antinociceptive effects.
